childPolicy.raw: 2 years and below: free while sharing with adults. 9 years and below sharing with 2 adults: 50% of half-twin rate. Sharing with 1 adult in a room: 100% of adult rate. Exclusive use of room: 100% of adult rate.

easterChristmasSupplement.raw: Easter Fri-Sat-Sun and Christmas 24,25,26,31 Dec 2026 & 1 Jan 2027: Resident adult KES2,000/child KES1,500 per night; Non-Resident US$30/adult, US$20/child per night.

singleRoomPolicy.raw: Max 4 single rooms at single rate per booking, rest at double rate.

groupReward.raw: 1 free pax per 15 paying clients, not applicable during promotional periods.

policies.releasePeriod: Block bookings confirmed min 60 days prior to arrival; room lists submitted min 30 days prior
policies.deposit: 50% deposit on confirmation, balance 30 days prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: 60-35 days: 25% of applicable rate per bed-night; 34-22 days: 50%; within 14 days: 75%; <14 days or no-show: 100%
